title: Acceptance probability of the lifted tester
statement: Let $T$ be a finite-seed randomized nonadaptive tester that makes $r$ queries to functions from the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^N$ to $\{\pm1\}$. For any nonnegative integer $n$, Boolean string $w\in\{0,1\}^n$, and proof table $p\colon\{0,1,\ldots,2^N-1\}\to\{0,1\}$, the tester obtained by redirecting $T$'s queries to the proof-table portion of the input and converting Boolean answers to signs has the same acceptance probability on the concatenated input $(w,p)$ as $T$ has on the sign-valued function on the sign cube encoded by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive tester with finite seed space and a seed probability law, querying the sign cube of dimension N and outputting signs
A Boolean string w of length n
A Boolean proof table on 2^N entries
